sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-14 (Sodir wellbore 5351) on the Volve field, a production well that is now plugged and abandoned.
The report period runs from 2007-12-05, the first report without a before-spud flag, to 2016-10-19, the last report.
The report span is 3241.96 days with 121 active days over 134 reports, of which 13 carry a before-spud flag.
The wellbore has seven campaigns.
Total depth is 3750.0 m measured depth, and the deepest reported true vertical depth is 3158.5 m.
Total activity time is 2945.75 h.
Primary lost time is 248.5 h, which is 8.44 % of activity time; possible lost time of 281.42 h (9.55 %) is reported separately and is not included in the primary figure.
The main outcome was that section 12, an 8.5 in hole, reached the total depth of 3750.0 m MD and ended on 2008-06-14; Sodir records the completion date as 2008-06-17.
Sodir records the entry date as 2007-12-05.

The last report (2016-10-19) is later than the Sodir completion date because the reports continue through the later workover campaigns and the plug and abandon campaigns; the plug and abandon campaign started on 2016-07-30.
Campaign 1 ran from 2007-12-05 to 2007-12-11, a span of 7.0 d with 7 active days; its dominant phase is drilling.
Campaign 2 ran from 2008-04-26 to 2008-07-10, a span of 76.0 d with 67 active days; its dominant phase is drilling.
Campaign 3 ran from 2009-03-06 to 2009-03-13, a span of 8.0 d with 8 active days; its dominant phase is workover.
Campaign 4 ran from 2010-09-10 to 2010-09-20, a span of 11.0 d with 11 active days; its dominant phase is workover.
Campaign 5 ran from 2012-01-27 to 2012-01-31, a span of 5.0 d with 5 active days; its dominant phase is workover.
Campaign 6 ran from 2016-07-30 to 2016-09-15, a span of 48.0 d with 21 active days; its dominant phase is plug abandon.
Campaign 7 ran from 2016-10-18 to 2016-10-19, a span of 2.0 d with 2 active days; its dominant phase is plug abandon.
Section 0 is the moving activity before the first section, on 2007-11-05; no hole size is reported and no new hole was drilled.
Section 1 is a 36.0 in hole drilled from 2007-11-06 to 2007-12-03, from 145.7 m to 204.0 m MD (TVD 204.0 m), with 204.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 16.0 m/h.
Section 2 is a 36.0 in section recorded on 2007-12-04 with no new hole, so no rate is reported.
Section 3 is a 26.0 in hole drilled from 2007-12-05 to 2007-12-11, from 206.0 m to 1083.0 m MD (TVD 1082.5 m), with 879.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 11.68 m/h.
Section 4 is a 26.0 in section from 2008-04-26 to 2008-04-30 at 1083.0 m MD with no new hole drilled.
Section 5 is a 26.0 in section recorded on 2008-05-10 at 1083.0 m MD with no new hole drilled.
Section 6 is a 17.5 in hole drilled from 2008-05-11 to 2008-05-21, from 1086.0 m to 2284.0 m MD (TVD 2281.0 m), with 1201.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 14.01 m/h.
Section 7 is a 12.25 in hole drilled from 2008-05-22 to 2008-05-27, from 2284.0 m to 2788.0 m MD (TVD 2728.4 m), with 504.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 12.92 m/h.
Section 8 has no hole size reported; it is a single report on 2008-05-28 at 2788.0 m MD with no new hole and no coded drilling hours.
Section 9 has no hole size reported; it ran from 2008-05-29 to 2008-06-04 at 2788.0 m MD with no new hole.
Section 10 has no hole size reported; it ran from 2008-06-05 to 2008-06-08 at 2788.0 m MD with no new hole.
Section 11 is a 12.25 in section recorded on 2008-06-09 at 2788.0 m MD with no new hole, so no rate is reported.
Section 12 is an 8.5 in hole drilled from 2008-06-10 to 2008-06-14, from 2791.0 m to 3750.0 m MD (TVD 3158.5 m), with 962.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 10.87 m/h.
Section 13 has no hole size reported; it ran from 2008-06-15 to 2008-06-17 at 3750.0 m MD, and its casing shoe is at 3695.0 m.
Section 14 (completion phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2008-06-18 to 2008-06-21 at 3750.0 m MD with no new hole.
Section 15 (completion phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2008-06-22 to 2008-06-25 at 3750.0 m MD with no new hole.
Section 16 (completion phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2008-06-26 to 2008-06-27 at 3750.0 m MD with no new hole.
Section 17 (completion phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2008-06-28 to 2008-07-02 at 3750.0 m MD with no new hole.
Section 18 (workover phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2008-07-03 to 2008-07-10 at 3750.0 m MD with no new hole.
Section 19 (workover phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2009-03-06 to 2009-03-13 and ends at 3750.0 m MD; its start depth is not reported.
Section 20 (workover phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2010-09-10 to 2010-09-20; its measured depth is not reported.
Section 21 (workover phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2012-01-27 to 2012-01-31; its measured depth is not reported.
Section 22 (plug and abandon phase, no hole size reported) ran from 2016-07-30 to 2016-10-19 from 3500.0 m MD; its end depth is not reported.

Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 196.8 m MD; the tools attribute a shoe at 251.7 m MD to section 1, while the activity text records the conductor set at TD 196.8 m, so the attribution should be checked against the report.
Section 2 starts below the 251.7 m shoe and sets no casing.
Section 3 starts below the 251.7 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 1076.9 m MD; the activity text for the casing run reads "RIH with 20" csg".
Sections 4 and 5 start below the 1076.9 m shoe and set no casing.
Section 6 starts below the 1076.9 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 2275.4 m MD.
Section 7 starts below the 2275.4 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 2783.5 m MD; the activity text reads "RIH with 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" csg".
Sections 8 to 12 start below the 2783.5 m shoe and set no casing.
Section 13 starts below the 2783.5 m shoe and sets casing with its shoe at 3695.0 m MD.
Section 14 starts below the 3695.0 m shoe and sets no casing; sections 15 to 22 also start below that shoe and set no casing.
Primary lost time totals 248.5 h, which is 8.44 % of the 2945.75 h activity time of the wellbore.
Primary lost time by cause: waiting on weather 141.0 h, repair 62.5 h, rig up and down 32.25 h and lost circulation 12.75 h.
By section, primary lost time is 88.25 h in section 1 (40.02 % of that section's activity time), the largest share on the well.
Primary lost time in section 3 is 5.0 h (2.98 % of section activity time) and in section 4 is 3.0 h (3.87 %).
Primary lost time in section 7 is 0.5 h (0.35 % of section activity time) and in section 10 is 2.0 h (2.08 %).
Primary lost time in section 16 is 5.5 h (11.46 % of section activity time), in section 18 is 26.5 h (14.25 %), in section 20 is 56.0 h (24.03 %) and in section 22 is 61.75 h (12.83 %).

Possible lost time is reported separately and is not added to the primary figures: 281.42 h in total (9.55 % of activity time), of which the largest parts are 80.0 h in section 19, 53.0 h in section 22 and 30.0 h in section 6.
Possible lost time in section 1 is 3.5 h, in section 18 is 29.5 h and in section 20 is 15.5 h; section 8 has 11.25 h and section 14 has 12.25 h.
On 2007-11-12 the template work for the conductor was held up for 15.5 h of waiting on weather because ROV visibility was poor; the ROV claw was damaged during this period.
On 2007-12-04 the ROV lost a three-finger claw in the hole during a 1.25 h activity while the drilling BHA was being run.

claims.value: UBHO sleeve had not been fastened correctly in the carrier

sentences.text: On 2007-12-05 the drilling BHA was pulled after the scientific drilling report that the UBHO sleeve had not been fastened correctly in the carrier, and junk was found trapped in the roller cones.
The UBHO repair on 2007-12-05 was a primary lost-time repair of 5.0 h, made up of several activities.
On 2008-05-22 drilling ran for 9.5 h at a limited rate because of MWD signal decoding problems.
On 2008-05-27 the lock-down sub for the casing hanger failed to set on the first attempts; a 3.0 h attempt ended with no go, and the lock was confirmed on 2008-05-28 after about 1.5 h.
On 2008-05-28 a possible lost-time repair of the forward PRS finger decoder took 3.75 h.

claims.value: Positioned cutter at 505,6 m. Performed cut.
Observed clear indication of cut, pressure dropped.

sentences.text: On 2016-08-03 the tubing was cut, recorded as "Positioned cutter at 505,6 m. Performed cut."; a second cut on 2016-08-04 was confirmed by a pressure drop, recorded as "Observed clear indication of cut, pressure dropped."

claims.value: Lost for 7 to 8 min, then static.

sentences.text: On 2016-08-04 a flow check after the second cut showed a loss, recorded as: "Lost for 7 to 8 min, then static."
On 2016-08-03 the A-annulus and ASV control-line troubleshooting took 4.25 h of primary repair time.
On 2016-08-04 a make-up of a crossover with the wrong threads cost 1.0 h of primary repair time.
On 2016-08-05 the tubing came free when the spear engaged, and the tubing connection was then overtorqued during swage make-up, which cost 3.0 h of primary repair time.

Plan conductor and template work around weather: section 1 carried 88.25 h of primary lost time, 40.02 % of its activity time, and the 15.5 h weather wait on 2007-11-12 shows how little ROV visibility was tolerated.
Verify tool build and bit condition before running junk-removal and drilling BHAs: the UBHO sleeve fault and the junk found in the bit cost 5.0 h of primary repair time on 2007-12-05.
Carry a spare MWD and check signal decoding before drilling the 12.25 in section: the MWD signal problem limited drilling for 9.5 h on 2008-05-22.
Rehearse the casing hanger lock-down sub run before running the next casing string: the lock-down attempts on 2008-05-27 ended with no go for 3.0 h, and the lock was confirmed only on 2008-05-28.

For plug and abandon, check connections and tong settings before make-up: the wrong-thread crossover (1.0 h) and the overtorqued tubing box (3.0 h) were both primary repairs, and the A-annulus valve troubleshooting cost 4.25 h.
Track possible lost time separately: the 281.42 h of possible time, including 80.0 h of waiting in section 19, was not counted as primary, so future planning should budget it as a distinct risk.

row.comments: Laid down top single at 190 m. Made up the cement stand. Washed down with the conductor to approx 40 cm above TD, 1000 lpm. Took digiquartz measurements. RIH and set conductor at TD 196.8 m. Confirmed top of housing 43 cm lower than F-7.
WOW for visibility to improve on template. Unable to engage hot-stab for centraliser rams. Damaged claw for ROV arm. Came to surface with ROV to repare claw, dived again with ROV.

Held toolbox talk prior to making up 26" drilling BHA. Removed masterbushing and ran 26" Bit / gMWD assy through rotary. Inserted gMWD probe in BHA as per Scientific instructions. Meanwhile ROV attempted to connect hose to CTS funnel. CTS hose was too short and the funnel had to be turned. ROV lost 3-finger claw when attempteing to turn CTS funnel.
Checked UBHO relative to scribeline. Checked and thightened UBHO sleeve. Inspected 26" bit at Centralizer deck - no wear observed.
Made up and RIH with 26" drilling BHA from 63 m to 196 m MD. Stabbed into CTS funnel while observing with ROV.
Washed down with 26" drilling BHA from 196 m to 209 m MD pumping at 2000 lpm.

Established drilling parameters. Drilled 26" hole section from 206 m to 211 m MD. Drilling parameters : Flow 3100 lpm / SPP 62 bar / 1-2 MT WOB / Rotation 125 RPM / String torque 1-3 kNm. Pumped 20 m3 hi-vis to clean the hole at 211 m MD. Scientifc drilling reported that UBHO sleeve had not been fastened correctly in the carrier. Decided to pull BHA for remedial action.
POOH with 26" drilling BHA from 211 m MD to 63 m MD. No drag observed when pulling BHA through conductor shoe. Racked back DC/jar and NMDC stands to access UBHO sub.

RIH with 20" csg from 414 m to 923 m MD. Filled string with SW every 5th joint. Average running speed 5 jnts/hr. Upweight 188 MT/down weight 144 MT at last joint before WH housing.

Observed tight spots at:
576-588 m: 20-25 MT drag
701-738 m: 15-18 MT drag 
800-825 m: 12-15 MT drag

Drilled 12 1/4" hole section from 2299 m to 2460 m MD. Drilling parameters : Flow 3500 lpm / SPP 232-238 bar / String RPM 120-140 / Bit RPM 220-240 / WOB 3-8 MT / Torque 6-13 kNm / ECD 1,32 /  Drilled with limited ROP 20-30 m/hr due to problems with MWD sinal decoding.
RIH with 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" csg on 5 1/2" HWDP landing string from 2640 to 2779 m MD.

1) Performed line test from cmt unit to HCR valve, 30/220 bar 5/10 min. Ok.
2) Pressured up to set lock down sub against closed top pipe ram. No go.
3) Checked for possible leaks in toolstring by opening IBOP and monitor gain in trip tank. No leak observed.
4) Pressured up to set lock down sub against closed btm pipe ram. No go.
5) Pulled lock down sub 1 m above landing no go. Flushed wellhead with 1100 lpm / 15 min.  Landed lock down sub and made 4 1/4 turns CW, torque 1700 Nm with neutral weight. Toolstring dropped 8 inches. Attempted to set lock down sub. No go.
Repaired decoder for finger on FWD PRS.

Landed lock down sub with 9 mT and made 4 1/4 turns CW, torque 1700 Nm with neutral weight. Toolstring dropped 7.5 inches. Closed UPR and verified correct line-up. 
Attempted to pressure up to 35 bar without sucess. Switched to second cmt pump and re-tried pumping up to 35 bar. Ok. Continued pressuring up to 207 bar and sat MS seal. Bled off pressure to zero. Confirmed lock by taking 40 mT overpull.
Correlated. Positioned cutter at 505,6 m. Performed cut. Indications of positive cut, heard shot at surface.

Re-attempted to pressure up A-annulus to 50 bar from cement unit.
Pumped 18ltrs from 10 bar to 50 bar. No indication of ASV opening.
Performed new line-up test and checked all valves.

Attempted to increase A-annulus pressure in stages of 10 bar to 120 bar with control line pressure of 480 bar. No indications of ASV opening. Pressure leaked off 1,5 bar/min. Bled off pressure.
Volume pumped to 120 bar, 23ltrs. Bled back same.

Pressured up A-annulus to 120 bar, then applied 480 bar pressure on control line. No indication of ASV opening. Pressure leaked off 1,5bar/min. Bled off control line and A-annulus.
Volume pumped 23 ltrs. Bled back same.

Performed line-up test to 120 bar, opened lo-torque valve. No pressure drop seen when opening lo-torque.
Checked all valves and hoses. R/D hose on A-annulus wing and observed cement residues coming out from hose.
Replaced hose.

Pressured up ASV control line to 420 bar. Pressured up A-annulus from cement unit to 50 bar. Pumped 136 ltrs from 10 bar to 50 bar (expected volume to pump 82 ltrs). Possible air/gas.
Bled off pressure through mud-gas separator.
Pressured up A-annulus again to 50 bar while applying 420 bar on ASV control line. Pumped 129 ltrs from 10 bar to 50 bar. Bled down pressure through mud-gas separator.

Recorded paramters:
80 rpm/1-4 kNm; 100 rpm/1-4 kNm
Up/down weight 82/80 ton
200 lpm/58 bar

Positioned cutter at 754,3 mMD and cut tubing. Observed clear indication of cut, pressure dropped.

Lined up on TT and flowchecked well for 10 min, initial loss rate 600 ltr/min. Lost for 7 to 8 min, then static.
Meanwhile: Performed TBT for POOH

M/U XO with wrong threads (NC38 Vam Eis - DS38). B/O XO and observed damage on XO.
Changed inserts in elevator and P/U single w/ XO from cantilever. M/U same to BHA.
Engaged spear, pulled tubing free at 168t hook weight. No indication of pins shearing noticed when tubing went free
M/U swage. Overtorqued connection due to wrong setting on casing tongs. Broke off swedge and inspected connection. Performed TBT prior to  pull out overtorqued box
POOH w/ tubing  with overtorqued box, arranged double securing to box. Set slips, removed double securing to box. Removed clamp and broke off single, L/D same
Inspected box treads. P/U backup 7in pup w/ expandable plug. Alligned pup over stump, made up 2x turns with chain tong, removed elevators and M/U connection w/ casing tong
